IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Fastidious" means very attentive to detail and hard to please. Its closest synonym among the options is "meticulous". (अत्यंत सावधान / नखरेबाज़)

◦ Example: The fastidious (meticulous) editor checked every sentence twice before approving the manuscript for publication.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Courage" means firmness of character; indomitable spirit and determination under pressure — different in sense from "fastidious".

• Option 3 "Comfort" means comfort or consolation received during a time of distress — different in sense from "fastidious".

• Option 4 "Contemporary" means relating to the present or recent times, as opposed to the past — different in sense from "fastidious".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of fastidious: meticulous. Antonyms: careless, sloppy, negligent.

 

5 Important Synonyms

2. Mirage (मृगतृष्णा / भ्रम): Illusion

3. Misanthropic (मानवद्वेषी): Antisocial

4. Mitigation (कमी): Reduction

5. Moderate (मध्यम): Reasonable

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Origin" means the place of origin or earliest known history of something — different in sense from "grotesque".

• Option 2 "Interesting" means arousing curiosity or interest; fascinating — different in sense from "grotesque".

• Option 4 "Native" means originating or occurring naturally in a particular place — different in sense from "grotesque".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of grotesque: bizarre. Antonyms: beautiful, normal, elegant.

Idiosyncrasy
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Peculiarity.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Idiosyncrasy" means a distinctive or peculiar feature or habit belonging to a particular person. Its closest synonym among the options is "peculiarity". (विशेषता / अनोखापन)

◦ Example: One of his idiosyncrasies (peculiarity) is that he always wears mismatched socks to important meetings.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2 "Shortage" means a scarcity or insufficient quantity of something — different in sense from "idiosyncrasy".

• Option 3 "Gloomy" means having an abnormal interest in death or disturbing subjects — different in sense from "idiosyncrasy".

• Option 4 "Trivial" means not having any serious purpose or value; silly — different in sense from "idiosyncrasy".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of idiosyncrasy: peculiarity.

 

5 Important Synonyms

1. Muddy (गंदा): Filthy

2. Munch (चबाना): Chew

3. Mundane (साधारण): Ordinary

4. Munificent (उदार): Generous

5. Mutate (परिवर्तन करना): Change
